name: cloudflare-mcp-pro
description: MCP server for the Cloudflare REST API v4 — 69 tools across DNS, Zones, Workers, KV, R2, D1, Pages, Queues, Tunnels, SSL, WAF, Email Routing, Logpush and Workers AI, with a server-side human-approval gate on every mutation.
author: helbertparanhos

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
envVars.description: Default account ID used when a tool needs an account and you don't pass account_id.

envVars.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_BASE
envVars.description: Override the API base URL (defaults to https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4).
